description: Browse public works with optional collection ID, dynasty name (category), kind slug (tag), sort and page. Returns public work URLs and page metadata.

category.description: Dynasty name from list_dynasties, for example 唐. Not a group name.

collection.description: Collection ID string from list_collections, for example "1".

sort.description: Omit for the site default descending order; views_count_asc reverses it. Collections follow curated show order.

tag.description: Work kind slug from list_types: shi (诗), ci (词), qu (曲), wen (文).

name: list_works
